scope.method: Reviewed all supplied biographies and selected follow-up answers, careers, named rows for disputed comparisons, and preparation/pay/lifestyle plan fields. Inspected targeted current matching and funding-note functions. Review only; no app, answer or expectation edits and no holdout files/outcomes inspected.
scope.interpretation: These are development cases with synthetic inferred responses, not student-authored answers or ground-truth career labels. Case dispositions assess defensible exploration and false specificity, not predictive accuracy.
scope.candidateRemedyNote: After this snapshot review, root reports narrowing subset domination to extra options mapped to at most two careers while preserving the two-question/two-domain requirement, plus a regression for broad bundled extras and a plain shared-task card label. Targeted current source inspection confirms the scope<=2 filter. This limits the documented generic-superset inversion; it does not establish medical/biological interest or solve multimodal prompts, equal evidence sets, synthetic-inference contradictions or translation specificity. Original findings are retained; revised development outcomes were not independently re-reviewed here.

outliers.issue: Generic device tasks establish biomedical specialization; superset prominence can invert specificity
outliers.evidence: The device-refinement option bundles machine, circuit, or medical device; no reviewed biography or separate selected option establishes biological/medical application. In 081/087 mechanical and electrical each have eight task questions yet are comparisonOnly with biomedical as their dominator, leaving biomedical alone featured. In 032 electrical is similarly demoted. The additional atomic choices are generic consultation/safety or broader machine/circuit mappings, not independent biomedical responsibility evidence.
outliers.proposedGeneralFix: A proper option-ID superset is not semantic specificity. Before allowing it to demote another supported occupation, require that extra endorsements distinguish that occupation/application rather than generic teamwork/user consultation, broad OR wording, or its more inclusive careerIds mapping. Otherwise show the engineering family and parallel named comparisons and ask a neutral application-domain question. Validate the mapping invariant across fields, not with per-student thresholds; do not change frozen answers, scores or clinical gates.

outliers.issue: Meaning/community/research bundles promote professional interpreting without cross-language evidence
outliers.evidence: Priya records family recipes in audio/photos and repairs clothes; full transcription was tedious. Seven endorsed prompts include meaning, culture, research and community, but none asks translating/interpreting between languages. Interpreting leads while its plan correctly says advanced proficiency in two languages. This is missing preference evidence, not proof that she cannot learn languages. In contrast 098 has actual comparison of story versions across languages.
outliers.proposedGeneralFix: Keep language work as a related question until a neutral cross-language activity preference is endorsed. Separate writing/editing, translation, information access and community expression in future question design. Qualification questions should describe readiness/training, not be used as aptitude gates or inferred from cultural background.

outliers.severity: P2 questionnaire/presentation ambiguity, not universally wrong careers
outliers.issue: Repeated multimodal story/scene prompts can manufacture a precise media specialty
outliers.evidence: Words/photos/moving images, scenes/images/sound, edited story/film/animation/photo series and mixed beginner projects recur across eight answers. Audio musicians, static mural/cartoon artists, performers and photographers can all accumulate film/animation/writing support without selecting that specific work. 058/064/086 display film alone despite static visual biography evidence; 064 has seven-question graphic/animation/photo support against film eight. Actual film cases 069/085, stop-motion 015 and writing cases 061/071 remain well grounded.
outliers.proposedGeneralFix: Treat these answers as common creative-story evidence, show a medium-neutral explanation and retain named supported comparisons. Ask whether the student wants writing, static visual design, photography, audio, performance, animation or editing before presenting one as especially established. Count repeated paraphrases as correlated evidence rather than independent confirmation. Preserve valid task-led exploration even with low broad-profile correlation; do not force three winners or retroactively make the biography a target label.

outliers.issue: Frozen inferred answers can contradict a biography routine or extend its domain
outliers.evidence: 083 explicitly avoids long editing after performances but inferred follow-ups endorse revisions and a film plan leads. 056 has moon/physics observations while inferred answers specifically endorse habitats, conservation and environmental risk. The recommender follows those selected answers; disagreement with the biography alone is not a scoring bug. Many supplied flags record low-confidence official inference and alternate-answer sensitivity.
outliers.proposedGeneralFix: Surface the conflicting or untested work routine in the explanation and a small trial: e.g. enjoy a short media exercise versus a daily editing routine, astronomy observation versus ecological fieldwork. Keep provenance and plausible alternate responses visible in evaluation. In live use, ask the learner rather than silently inferring agreement; preserve the frozen benchmark payload and do not tune against biography outcomes.

outliers.severity: P3 conditional planning risk; no new arithmetic bug established
outliers.issue: Small surpluses and location/training assumptions must remain explicit
outliers.evidence: 015 shows about $19/month, 054 about $36, 089 about $90, while financial stages are post-qualification except 094 explicitly paid apprenticeship. Several biographies are outside Austin/Texas or leave higher-study funding unresolved. The provided development plan excerpt does not contain full debt/cost/source assumptions; current trainingFundingNote explicitly says unresolved funding and entered-loans-only.
outliers.proposedGeneralFix: Keep the corrected adjacent funding condition, qualified-versus-training stage, geography/source dates and zero-borrowing interpretation visible. For a user-owned plan, compare actual local/nonresident tuition, living, access costs, hours, benefits and debt sensitivity rather than treating a small positive scenario as a promise. Do not fabricate debt or aid, assume health/disability costs, or discard an interest because the chosen lifestyle is expensive.

limits: No holdout file, holdout result, or newly inferred answer payload outside the one authorized development-review file was inspected. Source inspection was targeted to current matching and financial-note behavior.
All 70 cases receive individual dispositions. No answer changes, target tuning, force-three policy, synthetic accuracy percentage or psychometric validity claim was used.

Parent-supplied fixes for preparation export, law duration, named RN/EMT and architecture cost examples were not re-audited exhaustively here; these 70 supplied plans do not exercise every corrected role. Current full funding-note source was verified. The compact plan fields do not support recertifying costs, wages, taxes, source freshness or financing.

Biographies describe ordinary interests and access differences, not career ground truth. A related alternative can be sensible without prior professional exposure. Health, neurodivergence, loss, culture, identity, wealth and caregiving must not stand in for a vocational preference or measured ability.

Except for the subset-rule/mapping issue, many concerning results are ambiguous questions or uncertain synthetic response inference rather than demonstrated algorithm defects. A precise-looking correlation is not confidence in a biography inference, success probability or proof of an occupation.

Open top sets with useful leads/full field access were credited as appropriate restraint. Negative broad correlation was not treated as grounds to erase eight specifically endorsed task answers. Parallel music, science, art and service interests were retained in interpretation.

The prewritten financial plan is a harness comparison of a displayed role, not evidence that the fictional learner independently committed to that occupation. Later qualified wages do not apply immediately after high school, and conditional affordability does not establish admission, a job, benefits, a work schedule or funded training.
